# Setup

## Packages

Load the standard packages and install `moderndrive`

```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: load

# install.packages("moderndive")

library(here)
library(tidyverse) 
library(haven) # not core tidyverse
library(summarytools)
library(gtsummary) 

# do not load moderndive(), use it specifically 
```

## Create an example dataframe

```{r}
#| label: df

# Create columns
literacy <- c(31.7, 79.3, 85.4, 41.0, 54.7, 97.9, 92.8, 67.1, 97.8, 60.4, 87.5, 99.1)
educ <- c(3.74, 10.4, 20.4, 4.46, 9.53, 78.6, 31.5, 16.2, 65.8, 10.3, 30.8, 40.1)

# Combine into a data frame
df <- data.frame(literacy, educ)

# View the data frame
print(df)

```

## Look at descriptive statistics

`moderndive::tidy_summary()` returns commonly used summary statistics in
a tidy format.

```{r}
#| label: tidy-summary

df |>
  moderndive::tidy_summary()

```

Create a scatterplot.

```{r}
#| label: scatterplot

# Create scatterplot
df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = literacy, y = educ)) +
  geom_point(color = "#18BC9C", size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Scatterplot of Education vs Literacy",
    x = "Literacy Rate (X)",
      y = "College enrollment (Y)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Add a regression line to the scatterplot.

```{r}
#| label: scatterplot-ols

# Create scatterplot with regression line
df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = literacy, y = educ)) +
    geom_point(color = "#18BC9C", size = 3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#3498DB") +
    labs(
      title = "Scatterplot of Education vs Literacy with Regression Line",
      x = "Literacy Rate (X)",
      y = "College enrollment (Y)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

```

# Regression

Use base R to run a regression.

```{r}
#| label: regression

lm(educ ~ literacy, data = df)

```

Run a correlation test.

```{r}
#| label: cor.test

cor.test(
     ~ educ + literacy,
     data = df,
     method = "pearson",
     na.action = na.omit
 ) 

```

Use `get_regression_table()` to run a regression.

```{r}
#| label: regress-table

model <- lm(educ ~ literacy, data = df)

moderndive::get_regression_table(model)

```

Visualize uncertainty

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#| label: scatterplot-se
#| message: false

# Create scatterplot with regression line
ggplot(df, aes(x = literacy, y = educ)) +
  geom_point(color = "#18BC9C", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#3498DB") +
  labs(
    title = "Scatterplot of Education vs Literacy",
    x = "Literacy Rate (X)",
    y = "College enrollment (Y)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

# Categorical IV

Create a categorical variable.

```{r}
#| label: cat-var

# Use mutate and case_when to add the country_group column
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    # create the variable
    country_group = case_when(
      literacy < 50 ~ "Low Literacy",
      literacy >= 50 & literacy <= 80 ~ "Medium Literacy",
      literacy > 80 ~ "High Literacy"),
    # put the categories in a specific order
    country_group = factor(
      country_group,
      levels = c(
        "Low Literacy",
        "Medium Literacy",
        "High Literacy"))
    )

head(df)

```


Visualize averages by category 

```{r}
#| label: barplot
#| output-location: slide

df |>
  group_by(country_group) |>
  summarize(
    mean_educ = mean(educ)) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = country_group,
      y = mean_educ,
      fill = country_group)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Average College Enrollment by Literacy Group",
    x = "Literacy Group",
    y = "Enrollment (%)") +
  theme_minimal()

```



Use `get_regression_table()` with a categorical IV.

```{r}
#| label: lm-2

model_2 <- lm(educ ~ country_group, data = df)

moderndive::get_regression_table(model_2)
```


Visualizing uncertainty

```{r} 
#| label: barplot-se

df |>
  group_by(country_group) |>
  summarize(
    mean_educ = mean(educ),
    se = sd(educ) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_educ - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_educ + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = country_group,
      y = mean_educ,
      fill = country_group)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper),
    width = .15,
    linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Average College Enrollment by Literacy Group",
    x = "Literacy Group",
    y = "Enrollment (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
